entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Hi there, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hello, Charlie. I need some help with a recent order. I'd like to start a return for an item.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88602. It's for the Apex Pro jersey.
Okay, I see the order right here. Just to be clear, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a preference, I suppose. I ordered the wrong size. It's a bit too tight across the chest, so I was hoping to exchange it for the next size up.

Understood. A comfortable fit is definitely important. Let me just check the delivery date... I see it was delivered 23 days ago. That's no problem at all. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day window for a standard return or exchange.
That's great to hear. So I can just send this one back for the larger size?
Exactly. I'm generating a prepaid return label for you right now, which I'll email over. Once we receive the original jersey, we'll ship out the new size to you immediately.

Okay, that works. Now, since I have to go through the trouble of packaging it and dropping it off, and I'll be without a jersey for a week or so, is there any way you could offer a small discount on the exchange? Maybe 10% for the inconvenience?

I appreciate you asking. While I can't offer a discount on the exchange, I can assure you the return shipping is completely free, and we'll process the new shipment as quickly as possible. The policy is set up for a direct exchange or a full refund, but doesn't allow for additional credits in this situation.
I see. No discount code for a future purchase, then?

Unfortunately not for a sizing issue, but the good news is you'll get the right size at no extra cost. The email with the shipping label has just been sent. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's fair enough. I've got the email. Thanks for your help, Charlie.
You're very welcome. Have a great day and enjoy your new jersey once it arrives!
